agents.name: claude
agents.description: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed.

agents.name: client-doc-skeptic
agents.description: Fresh-context adversarial review of client-facing engagement documents (agreements, invoices, proposals, engagement reports, call-prep docs) before they ship. Role-plays the paying client reading line by line with a calculator and the other documents open side by side. Hunts for cross-document contradictions (a price, duration, or date that differs between two artifacts), unsupported numbers that appear exactly once with no basis, internal-only content leaked into a client-facing doc, and anything a careful counterparty would catch and lose trust over. Returns SHIP or HOLD with each offending claim quoted and located. Must be briefed ONLY on the artifact set and the facts file, with NO knowledge that it is a revision and NO prior drafts. Use for "is this ready to send to the client", "run the paranoid client on this", or as the final gate of the client-doc-gate skill.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Expert code review with confidence-based filtering. Reviews for security, quality, React/Next.js patterns, and backend issues. Only reports issues with >80% confidence.

agents.name: code-simplifier:code-simplifier
agents.description: Simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving all functionality. Focuses on recently modified code unless instructed otherwise.

agents.name: Explore
agents.description: Fast read-only search agent for locating code. Use it to find files by pattern (eg. "src/components/**/*.tsx"), grep for symbols or keywords (eg. "API endpoints"), or answer "where is X defined / which files reference Y." Do NOT use it for code review, design-doc auditing, cross-file consistency checks, or open-ended analysis — it reads excerpts rather than whole files and will miss content past its read window. When calling, specify search breadth: "quick" for a single targeted lookup, "medium" for moderate exploration, or "very thorough" to search across multiple locations and naming conventions.

agents.name: feature-dev:code-architect
agents.description: Designs feature architectures by analyzing existing codebase patterns and conventions, then providing comprehensive implementation blueprints with specific files to create/modify, component designs, data flows, and build sequences

agents.name: feature-dev:code-explorer
agents.description: Deeply analyzes existing codebase features by tracing execution paths, mapping architecture layers, understanding patterns and abstractions, and documenting dependencies to inform new development

agents.name: feature-dev:code-reviewer
agents.description: Reviews code for bugs, logic errors, security vulnerabilities, code quality issues, and adherence to project conventions, using confidence-based filtering to report only high-priority issues that truly matter

agents.name: general-purpose
agents.description: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you.

agents.name: outreach-requirements-auditor
agents.description: Hard pass/fail gate for cold outreach messages. Audits a cold email / LinkedIn note / DM / follow-up against the non-negotiable Eltrus outreach requirements (tease-don't-attach, no unverified absence claims, char limits counted including spaces, signature/domain correctness, length, no em-dashes, reply-seeking CTA, opt-out line). Reports each rule as PASS or FAIL with the exact offending text. Use before any outreach message is sent.

agents.name: Plan
agents.description: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs.

agents.name: receiver-persona-critic
agents.description: Fresh-context critic that role-plays the actual recipient of a cold outreach message (a named founder / ops lead / care lead) and judges whether they'd reply. Use to validate cold emails, LinkedIn notes/DMs, and follow-ups. Must be briefed ONLY on the receiver persona and the final message, with NO knowledge that it's a revision and NO prior drafts, so the judgement isn't contaminated by improvement-curve grading. This is the PERSUASION gate, one of TWO gates: it judges "would this human reply" and can be talked into liking a message that breaks a hard rule. The programmatic outreach-requirements-auditor is the other gate and enforces the hard rules this one cannot. Outreach ships only when both pass.

agents.name: report-writer
agents.description: Reads source documents (PDFs, code, text files) and writes analysis/comparison/summary reports to markdown files. Use this agent whenever you need a subagent to actually produce output files on disk rather than returning text.

agents.name: statusline-setup
agents.description: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting.

agents.name: stripe:Company Researcher
agents.description: Research a company from its URL or description to infer Stripe Connect integration shape

agents.name: teardown-skeptic
agents.description: Fresh-context adversarial go/no-go on a finished CX teardown plus the cold email it ships with, before anything is sent. Stress-tests every claim for false-absence, fabricated or stale numbers, and anything a founder could fact-check line by line and catch out, plus email/teardown agreement, persona fit, and deliverability. Returns SEND or HOLD with the offending claims quoted, and fixes trivial issues in place. Use for "is this teardown safe to send", "would this embarrass me if they checked it", "go/no-go on the [brand] teardown". Must be briefed ONLY on the artifacts (teardown, email, verification notes) with NO knowledge it's a revision. Owns the truth-and-credibility layer that `receiver-persona-critic` and `outreach-requirements-auditor` don't cover.
